LESSON: READING 4.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: VISUALS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals, part of Strand 4 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to interpret visuals correctly? 2. How do visuals like photos and videos enhance our understanding of a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read age-appropriate digital texts in different formats such as audio, video and animated stories,

2. view cartoons, mimes, pictures, photographs, comics showing an underpass, foot bridge, luggage rack, roundabout, railway crossing,

3. work together to interpret and discuss visuals,

4. predict happenings in cartoons or comics and write down their thoughts.

5. conduct virtual tours on google maps and find the direction of various places on the map,

6. use google maps, digital maps and printed maps to give directions, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read age-appropriate digital texts in different formats such as audio, video and animated stories,
2. view cartoons, mimes, pictures, photographs, comics showing an underpass, foot bridge, luggage rack, roundabout, railway crossing,
3. work together to interpret and discuss visuals,
4. predict happenings in cartoons or comics and write down their thoughts.
5. conduct virtual tours on google maps and find the direction of various places on the map,
6. use google maps, digital maps and printed maps to give directions, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner uses technology to conduct virtual tours on google maps and find the

direction of various places on the map.

• Learning to Learn: The is developed as the learner builds on their learning experience by locating information from a

simple map and make short sentences.

Values:
● Unity: It is developed as the learner works together with peers as they discuss and interpret visuals.

● Love: This is enhanced as the learner appreciates views from peers when viewing and interpreting visuals.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-esteem: This is developed as the learner is able to interpret visuals independently for information and directions in their

daily experiences.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of interpreting visuals with their learning of concepts such as map reading in Social Studies.
